names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 14428, «Святитель Герман (Косолапов), епископ Вольский, сщмч.», with the rank words left off; the office it carries is the one printed.

death.note: The year the calendar's day line prints for the two of them together: «Сщмчч. Германа, епископа Вольского, и Михаила пресвитера (1919)».

feast.note: His name page lists one other day, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of Russia. One row per church is the schema, so the second day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, 27 сентября ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Германа, епископа Вольского, и Михаила пресвитера (1919).»

attestations.note: Not checked: doxologia.ro's own 27 septembrie was not read (2026-10-04); the Romanian calendar does not generally keep the Russian new martyrs.
Not checked: saint.gr/09/27 was not read for him (2026-10-04).
Not checked: pravoslavno.rs's Prologue page for the civil day this Julian 27 September falls on was not read (2026-10-04).
